library: Accounting — from scratch to CPA and beyond
source: Maps and notes in our own words, following the KASNEB CPA paper list (kasneb.or.ke/cpa, checked 14 Oct 2026); standards named (IFRS, IAS, ISA, IPSAS) but never quoted; videos link to YouTube. Not a replacement for the official syllabus or study packs. © 2026 Kewal Bhatt (Keval Krishna Das), Nairobi.

parts.title: Start here · Accounting from zero
parts.subtitle: Never studied accounting? Begin here. Only adding and subtracting needed.

parts.title: Step 1 · CPA Foundation
parts.subtitle: Going for CPA? Six papers, CA11 to CA16. New to accounting? Do "Start here" first.

parts.title: Step 2 · CPA Intermediate
parts.subtitle: Six papers, CA21 to CA26: company law, finance, reporting, audit, management accounting, tax.

parts.title: Step 3 · CPA Advanced
parts.subtitle: Four compulsory papers (CA31, CA32, CA33, CA34S3) and at least one specialisation (CA34S1, CA34S2 or CA34S4).

parts.title: At work · Accounting in Kenya
parts.subtitle: For people already working: iTax, eTIMS, payroll, Excel, software, month-end.

parts.title: The world of accounting
parts.subtitle: Accounting as a whole: its branches, how each industry keeps books, and the qualifications beyond CPA.

nodeData.topic: Accounting — from scratch to CPA and beyond
nodeData.note: Never studied accounting? Begin at 'Start here · Accounting from zero'. Going for CPA? Follow Step 1 to Step 3 in KASNEB order (CA11 … CA35P). Curious about the whole field? Open 'The world of accounting': its branches, how different industries keep their books, and other qualifications. Already working? Open 'At work'. Every map has worked examples in KES, flashcards and videos. New maps are added every day.
